conventions.dayIndex: 0=Sun(א) .. 6=Sat(ש), week starts Sunday, no wrap unless a rule says so
conventions.session: {kind:'run', slot} | {kind:'strength', slug, volumePct?} | {kind:'mobility'|'walk'|'race', minutes?} ; array order inside a day = in-day order
conventions.layout: keys '0'..'6'; a missing key = rest day
conventions.exact: true → layout must match exactly; false → any layout passing mustHold + constraints passes
conventions.today: documentation only (traced by hand, not executed): verdict yes|partial|no; path P1 signup default, P2 JIT run picker, P3 strength questionnaire, P4 schedule builder/weaver, P5 Kelly phase 2, CR calm return, AL alignment, AG agenda drag, AT adviseToday (Kelly context)

ruleIds.H3: no heavy legs (legs/lower_body) the day before quality or long run, incl. Sat→Sun
ruleIds.H5: shared day: quality run before strength (R2/R3)
ruleIds.H6: same-pattern recovery (push/pull/legs/straight-arm load ≥0.7) per minRecoveryHours; OAPU→pull ≥72h
ruleIds.H7: no cns≥0.7 skill within 48h after muscle-up (WARN_03)
ruleIds.H10: race: no legs within 72h, no quality within 48h before
ruleIds.S4: keep user's days (w5, w2 if system-default)
ruleIds.S7: moderate legs (full_body) day before key run (w6)
ruleIds.S8: long right after quality / quality right after long (w4)
ruleIds.S10: consecutive training days over level comfort (w3)
